profile.name: Van Philip Panugan
profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.description: An emerging developer on a mission to learn, build, and grow—exploring the intersection of web development, cloud technology, and AI one challenge at a time.

projects.title: Project CovidRecon
projects.description: A PyQt5 and Tweepy-based desktop application that tracks and visualizes COVID-19 case statuses across the National Capital Region in the Philippines.
projects.challenges: Aggregating real-time social data and presenting it through an intuitive desktop UI during the early pandemic.
projects.solutions: Built a scheduled data pipeline with Tweepy and visualized trends using PyQt5 widgets.
projects.results: Delivered a working prototype that helped visualize regional case trends for academic assessment.

projects.title: Jzaki Enterprises Website
projects.description: A brand showcase and customer inquiry platform for a local food manufacturing enterprise, modernizing product discovery for traditional Filipino treats.
projects.challenges: Creating a mobile-first experience that respects the brand's heritage while improving customer inquiries.
projects.solutions: Implemented a clean component system, responsive layouts, and clear call-to-action flows.
projects.results: Improved online presence and streamlined customer engagement for the business.
